allowed.entry:manifest/actions/*.actions.ts: an Agenda manifest fragment (one feature's routes, verbs, panels and hooks) is listed by the generator into the git-ignored manifest/generated/actions.ts (scripts/gen/registries.ts), which knip does not read, so each fragment file is an entry by its name: a new route edits one fragment and no list (docs/standards/architecture). Not a pending-port gap.
